name: text_cache_news
note: opens language file idx6 (DS:055e+lang*16+0xc: 49/248.HES), reads offset index (0x322 bytes) into DAT_609b, loads texts for player's news items (DS:455f + player*600, stride 0x1e, count DS:7286[player]), the 3 news slots DS:3d4b+player*0x78 and (room 2 substate 2) DS:6127 into cache DS:729a (0x18 entries x 6 bytes {id; char *text})

name: text_cache_load_news
note: note arg order (slot, id). length = idx[id]-idx[id-1]; far_calloc + hes_read(file DS:8ed8, buf, idx[id-1], len) -> DS:729a[slot]

name: text_cache_news_free
note: far_free_ptr all 0x18 entries of DS:729a cache

name: text_cache_titles
note: film texts from language file idx2 (207/252.HES, index 0x192 bytes): selects films depending on room (0: single film 'player' arg; 0x1f: archive+today's schedule; 99/100: all schedules; 4: dealer offers DS:2463 + archive; 8: offers + auction lists DS:19cd/1aed; 9/5/0xc: screenplay/episode based ids from DS:713c) and loads them into cache DS:63c5 (49 x 10 bytes {id; char *title; char *descr})

name: text_cache_has_film
note: -1 if id present in DS:63c5[0..48], else 0

name: text_cache_load_film
note: reads record id (Pascal-style length-prefixed strings) and stores 2 strings (title, description) into DS:63c5[slot]

name: text_cache_titles_free
note: fixed==0: frees slots 3..48, else slots 0..2 (via text_cache_film_free)

name: text_cache_film_free
note: clears id and far_free_ptr both strings of DS:63c5[slot]

name: text_cache_descr
note: notes name kept; actually SERIES texts: language file idx3 (47/251.HES, index 0x66 bytes = 51 series), selection per room like text_cache_titles; cache DS:65af (15 x 0x5a bytes {id; 22 x char*} = title/descr + episode texts)

name: text_cache_has_series
note: -1 if id present in DS:65af[0..14], else 0

name: text_cache_load_series
note: loads 22 length-prefixed strings of the record into DS:65af[slot]

name: text_cache_series_free_slot
note: clears id, far_free_ptr 22 strings of DS:65af[slot]

name: text_cache_series
note: notes name kept; language file idx4 (45/250.HES, index 0x66) - screenplay/show texts: rooms 9 (bag list DS:1a25 + agency offers DS:194a, entry 0x22 first), 5 (studio DS:6145), 0xc (shopping lists DS:732c); cache DS:6af5 (10 x 0x42 bytes {id; 16 x char*})

name: text_cache_series_free
note: frees all 10 entries of DS:6af5 cache
